reports.title: PUBLIC STORAGE REPORTS THIRD QUARTER 2026 RESULTS AND RAISES GUIDANCE

guidance.heading: 2026 Guidance
section: Public Storage raised its previously provided guidance for net operating income growth (Same Store and Non-Same Store), and Core FFO per share as included in the table below.

Current | Prior | Guidance Adjustment
Low | High | Low | High
Revenue growth | —% | 0.5% | (0.7)% | 0.3% | 0.5%
Expense growth | 1.5% | 2.5% | 2.0% | 3.0% | (0.5)%
Net operating income growth | (0.8)% | 0.2% | (2.0)% | (0.3)% | 0.9%
Non-Same Store net operating income | $355,000 | $363,000 | $343,000 | $357,000 | $9,000
Core FFO per share: | $16.90 | $17.10 | $16.75 | $17.05 | $0.10
*Additional guidance assumptions can be found in the Company’s accompanying quarterly financial supplement.
*Guidance adjustment column represents the absolute nominal change between midpoints of current and prior issued guidance.
*Non-Same Store net operating income excludes the impact of NSA and PS Canada.
